global: This tonkotsu ramen features a rich, creamy broth in a blue-and-white patterned bowl. Topped with chopped green onions and a single nori sheet, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue geometric pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, and rich, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and partially submerged, with a glossy surface and visible bubbles clinging to its edges.
